intro: Wiki content is edited through the site APIs. Other tables depend on the bot; read-only tables cannot be edited.

descriptions.db_sagas: Create or edit a saga here, then link it to a character version.
descriptions.db_character_variants: Add one row per character, version, and saga. Linked sagas appear in the second selector on the character wiki page.
descriptions.db_character_variant_technique_uses: Add one row for each cited use of a technique in a saga. The precise source and chronology appear on the character page.
descriptions.db_character_variant_appearances: Add one row per supplementary photo. Each row creates a square preview button on the portrait for the selected version and saga. A transformation link is optional; the photo, alternative text, source and order remain editable here.
descriptions.db_character_variant_staff_credits: One card per episode: featured scene, animation supervisor, credited animators, illustration, and sources.
descriptions.db_character_variant_voice_actors: Link performers to this saga. Portraits, names, and profiles are edited in the voice cast catalog.
descriptions.db_battles: Add a DBFR battle image and its alternative text. It appears with a left-side fade on associated character pages.

characterEditor.title: Edit a character page
characterEditor.intro: Follow the steps: choose a character and version, select a saga, then edit its content without losing your place.
characterEditor.versionHelp: The version determines which sagas, relationships, and content are shown next.
characterEditor.loadVersionsError: Linked versions could not be loaded.
characterEditor.noSagas: No saga is linked to this version yet. Add one below first.
characterEditor.loadSagasError: Sagas for this version could not be loaded.
characterEditor.addSagaToVersion: Link a saga to this version
characterEditor.chooseSagaFirst: Choose a saga before opening its content.
characterEditor.generalProfileHelp: General character details are shared across sagas.

story.title: Story, appearance, and official data
story.description: Form, outfit, age, role, affiliation, power, summary, highlights, and the main image for this saga.

relations.title: Family, friends, and enemies
relations.description: Edit relationships for this version and saga, including category, description, and order.

formsAndTechniques.title: Available transformations and techniques
formsAndTechniques.description: Choose the forms and techniques the character has reached at this point in the story.

techniqueUses.title: Technique uses and sources
techniqueUses.description: Record techniques used in this saga, their order, and their precise sources.

battles.title: Battles in chronological order
battles.description: Assign battles to this saga and set their order on the character page.

appearances.title: Photos and alternate appearances
appearances.description: Add transformation thumbnails. Each visible photo creates a button on this saga’s portrait.

additionalInformation.title: Anecdotes, name origin, and behind the scenes
additionalInformation.description: Write saga-specific additional information in the Markdown article. Level-two headings become sections, supporting text, images, sources, and internal links.
additionalInformation.articleHelp: Use one ## heading per section (Anecdotes, Name origin, and so on). Add images with ![description](URL), source links, and links to DBFR pages.

voiceActors.title: Voice cast for this saga
voiceActors.description: Link performers from the catalog, add a role note, then set order and visibility. Edit portraits and biographies in the voice cast catalog.

animationCredits.title: Fight scene animation credits
animationCredits.description: Add one card per episode: scene, supervisor with DBFR profile link, animation team, crop-ready illustration, and source links.
